protocol.initialization: all seven coefficients and Adam moments zero; no prior weights
protocol.input: two ordered RGB triples divided by 255, plus bias; shared across pixels and cases
protocol.constant_input: all six RGB channels zero, bias one
protocol.schedule: k=1..256: Newton visual, constant if k<=16; then Adam visual, constant
protocol.loss: equal anchor mean, equal positive/negative BCE if both exist, full BCE if one class
protocol.batch: all twelve certified stationary cases in unchanged manifest order
protocol.input_loading: decode only past_pairs and observed_response_envelopes; no futures or reference
protocol.evaluation: common initial and four final arms only; full objective also before and after each update
protocol.work_scope: data through scientific payload fsync/hash, final provenance and journal close; final receipt and console excluded
protocol.claim: development association fitting only; comparison of two bounded recipes, not equal-compute efficiency or optimizer-only causality
